exposure: Outpatient misoprostol administration for labor induction
Inpatient misoprostol administration for labor induction
outcome: Cancellation of induction due to labor
cohort: The study included 5885 women with live deliveries, comprising 296 who received outpatient misoprostol and 5589 who received misoprostol only as an inpatient.
finding: Outpatient misoprostol was associated with higher birth weight and gestational age, and increased adjusted odds of canceling an induction due to labor, indicating it is a safe and viable option for women requiring induction of labor.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the incidence of cesarean section between the outpatient and inpatient misoprostol groups.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, with higher values observed in the outpatient misoprostol group, but no specific inclusion range was mentioned.
gest_age: Measured as an outcome, with higher values observed in the outpatient misoprostol group, but no specific inclusion range was mentioned.
